meta_description: JM Painters & Decorators Birmingham. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes. Call 07496 036805.
hero_subhead: From tired walls to stunning rooms. Interior and exterior work done right, on time, and without the mess.
services_subhead: Professional interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and finishing work for homes and small businesses.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Full room repaints, accent walls, and feature finishes. We prepare every surface properly and use quality paints that last. Your home stays clean throughout.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior work including fascias, soffits, and masonry. We protect your property from the elements and refresh its kerb appeal.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Expert hanging on pattern and plain wallpaper. We handle tricky corners, archways, and statement designs — the finish is seamless and professional.

services.title: Woodwork & Doors
services.desc: Sanding, priming, and painting internal doors, skirting boards, and fitted furniture. We deliver a smooth, durable finish that transforms dark rooms.

services.title: Texture & Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Artexing, stippling, Venetian plaster, and other premium effects. We create depth and character while keeping maintenance low.

services.title: Commercial & Rental Refresh
services.desc: Quick turnarounds for lettings and small commercial spaces. We work efficiently to get properties ready on deadline without cutting corners.

about_pullquote: I started this because I got sick of seeing botched jobs and overinflated quotes.
about_para_1: JM Painters & Decorators has been transforming homes and businesses across Birmingham for over 15 years. We began as a one-man operation and grew through word of mouth and repeat customers who trusted us to get the work done right. Every project gets the same care and attention—no rush jobs, no shortcuts.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our preparation. We take time to protect your furniture and floors, and we never cut corners on surface prep because poor prep is why paint fails. Our customers return because we listen, we turn up on time, and we leave the site clean. We're proud to be recommended by estate agents and landlords across the city.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Needed my lounge redecorating before Christmas. JM came out, gave us a fair quote with no pressure, and got the work done in two days. Walls look brilliant, barely any mess. Wouldn't hesitate to call them again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had the exterior painted including soffits and guttering. The prep work was thorough, paint quality is excellent, and the finish is smooth as anything. Looked like they really cared about getting it right. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Claire R.

reviews.text: Wallpapered two bedrooms and the hallway. The bloke who did it was meticulous—took time around corners and where the ceiling meets the wall. Very professional. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: James H.
